# Yugos

> Yugos is a Bittensor subnet that pays for a router. Train a small routing model, package it, and submit it. The hosted service runs it on a shared exam, grades the provider reply, and records spend and time. Validators pay the champions.

An agent that follows this file can install the tools, train a router against public benchmarks, and submit it. Read the linked pages before changing the contract or the score.

## What to train

Train a routing model. Package `model.py`, `model.safetensors`, `models.json`
and all inference assets. `load_model(weights_path)` returns an object with
`route(input) -> ModelChoice`. The output has only
`provider_id`, `model_id` and `effort`, matching a declared choice.

The host forwards the original conversation, tools and settings. There is one
logical generation per native model turn, no response callback, and no prompt
editing, voting, escalation or answer repair. Trained weights must meaningfully
influence routing. Generic preprocessing, output decoding, cost penalties and
configured cost/latency tradeoffs are allowed, even when their coefficients are
not learned. Benchmark-specific detectors, memorized evaluation-question routes,
exploiting evaluation order, and decorative weights are not allowed.

The starter is a fixed-model local baseline. Replace its constant choice with
learned inference before competitive submission. Read [docs/miner.md](docs/miner.md)
for the full submission contract.

## The score you are fitting

Contest `competition-v0.0.13` promotes a challenger `A` over champion `K` when every category passes its gates and the paired-bootstrap lower bound of net value is greater than `0.2`.

```text
m = 100
k = 300
V_c = m * anchor_cost_per_question[c]
T_c = k * anchor_time_per_question[c]
H = 2
u_i = H if question i is hard, else 1

NV_c = 100 * Σ_i [ u_i * (g_A,i - g_K,i) - (s_A,i - s_K,i) / V_c - (t_A,i - t_K,i) / T_c ] / n_c
NV   = 0.40 * NV_chat_qa + 0.35 * NV_math_code + 0.25 * NV_agentic
```

Grades are in `[0, 1]`. A wrong or missing answer is `0` and still counts its spend and time. A hard question is one the calibration panel did not solve. `NV = +1` is one extra percentage point of that category, after spend and time.

One extra correct answer is worth `100` times the anchor's spend on that question and `300` times the anchor's working time. Matching the anchor's extra spend on every question costs `1` point. Matching its extra time costs about `0.33` points. The goal is a higher `NV` than the current champion: more correct answers, less spend, and less time, across all three categories.

Category totals also have to stay under the safety ceilings: chat/QA `10800` seconds, math/code `12600` seconds, agentic `36000` seconds. Quality has to stay near the category high-water mark. One failed category blocks promotion.

Only champions are paid: current `85%`, previous `10%`, the one before `5%`. A seat that does not exist yet stays with the current champion. Second place in a single match receives nothing. Train to take the crown.

The full expansion, the gates, and the payout are in [docs/scoring.md](docs/scoring.md).

## Models you may call

Fetch the active world card and use its `provider_id` and `model_id` strings. Prices are USD per million tokens under `token_prices`. `card.roles` are grader and simulator models. Leave them out of `models.json`.

```sh
curl -s https://upload.yugos.ai/world/cards/active \
  | jq -r '.card.providers[] | .provider_id as $p | .token_prices | keys[] | [$p, .] | @tsv'
```

Known provider ids: `openai`, `anthropic`, `google`, `openrouter`, `venice`, `gm`, `engy`, `spacexai`, `nous`, `deepseek`, `chutes`, `near`, and `0g`. The card is the authority. For a local run, set that provider's key yourself (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `VENICE_API_KEY`, `GM_API_KEY`, `ENGY_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY` for `spacexai`, `NOUS_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `CHUTES_API_KEY`, `NEAR_AI_API_KEY`, `ZEROG_API_KEY`). The runner reads the environment. It does not load a `.env` file. The packer skips hidden files, so a `.env` beside `model.py` is not uploaded.

## Procedure

Stay on testnet until one submit succeeds. The default network is mainnet (subnet 34, `https://upload.yugos.ai`). `--network test` is subnet 169 and needs `--endpoint` or `YUGOS_ENDPOINT`.

```sh
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install "yugos @ git+https://github.com/BitMind-AI/yugos.git" \
  "yugos-evals @ git+https://github.com/BitMind-AI/yugos.git#subdirectory=packages/yugos-evals"

btcli wallet create --wallet miner
btcli subnet burn-cost --network test 169
btcli subnet register --network test --wallet miner --hotkey default --netuid 169

git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/BitMind-AI/yugos.git
cd yugos/examples/starter-router
```

Then:

1. Fetch the world card. Put the models you call in `models.json`, using ids from that card.
2. Fit the policy in `model.safetensors` and read it from `load_model`. The goal is the net value above: more correct answers than the champion, for less money, in less time.
3. Pack and run a small public slice of each category. `yugos-evals list` prints the catalog.

```sh
yugos pack . --output router.zip
yugos-evals pack build --benchmark aime2025 --limit 20 --out aime.pack.tar
yugos-evals run --pack aime.pack.tar --bundle router.zip --log-dir runs/a
```

`--max-cost` defaults to `100` and caps your own router and grader spend. Repeat for the other categories. Read `runs/a/measurements.json` for grade, spend, and time on each question.

4. Keep the previous ZIP as the baseline. `yugos-evals compare runs/a runs/b` reports whether B beats A on that slice. That local report uses the library's default dollar values and does not apply the contest's anchor time price. Screen with it, then judge a candidate by the formula above on the questions you ran: keep a change when the grade gain is worth the extra spend at `V_c` and the extra time at `T_c`.
5. Submit the winner on testnet. Confirmation can lock about `$100` and start a paid eval. The receipt is written next to the ZIP. Keep it. Resume an interrupted upload by rerunning the same command.

```sh
yugos pack . --output router.zip
yugos submit router.zip --network test --endpoint "$YUGOS_ENDPOINT" --wallet miner --hotkey default
yugos status router.receipt.json --network test --endpoint "$YUGOS_ENDPOINT" --wallet miner --hotkey default
```

`yugos pack` writes `manifest.json` into the ZIP. Leave that file to the packer.

6. After one successful testnet submit, register the same hotkey on mainnet and submit a new receipt. Fund the coldkey with mainnet TAO first. Testnet TAO does not pay the mainnet fee. Do not reuse the testnet receipt.

```sh
btcli subnet burn-cost 34
btcli subnet register --wallet miner --hotkey default --netuid 34
yugos submit router.zip --wallet miner --hotkey default
yugos status router.receipt.json --wallet miner --hotkey default
```
